bot.intro: Look up players, inspect matches, check recent history, browse loadouts, and more—without making your squad leave the server.
bot.previewDetails: Rank · record · level · DPM · HPM · MPM
bot.previewHint: Type a name or player ID. PaladinsCat handles the rest.
bot.featuresTitle: Useful answers, without the tab switching
bot.featuresIntro: PaladinsCat turns the same trusted data behind the website into fast, readable Discord responses.
bot.featurePlayerBody: Pull a player profile with rank, win/loss record, account level, and per-minute performance metrics.
bot.featureMatchBody: Turn any match ID into an optimized two-team image, complete with a link to the full match page.
bot.featureHistoryBody: Review a player's ten latest matches with champion, result, K/D/A, and quick links for deeper analysis.
bot.featurePrepBody: Browse saved decks or compare champion ranked performance across global and selected lobby tiers.
bot.commandsIntro: Every feature uses Discord's native slash commands, with autocomplete where it helps.
bot.commandHelp: Open a private command index and quick-start guide.
bot.commandPlayer: Find a player profile, rank, record, level, and core performance metrics.
bot.commandMatch: Create a polished two-team match image from a match ID.
bot.commandHistory: See a player's ten most recent matches and K/D/A results.
bot.commandCurrent: Check the player's current-match response when available.
bot.commandLoadouts: Browse saved loadout decks grouped by champion.
bot.commandChampion: Read database-backed ranked records, lobby tier, performance metrics, and talents globally or for a selected tier range.
bot.privacyTitle: The bot listens for commands—not conversations.
bot.privacyBody: PaladinsCat uses Discord's native slash commands and the standard Guilds intent. It does not request privileged message-content, presence, or member intents.
bot.permissionReplies: Permission to send embeds and match images
bot.finalBody: Add the bot, type /help, and give your community instant access to Paladins stats where they already play together.
bot.finalNote: You must have permission to add apps to the selected Discord server.
